FFmpeg.wasm shared-memory core 0.12.10

Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/@ffmpeg/core-mt/-/core-mt-0.12.10.tgz
Package integrity (SHA-512, base64): atyRTOpa58bLCIgd6GXBZAXWyWD3AUoQyzxqjvGhp9MuSzdILtOTI62ffLswBsCnLq15lQ8IETHUpm1oe4V9FQ==
Corresponding upstream source and build instructions:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v12.15
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/v12.15/Dockerfile

The Dockerfile specifies FFmpeg n5.1.4, the x264 and x265 forks, the other linked
libraries, and the Emscripten toolchain. The pinned source tree includes the
build scripts and WebAssembly patches.

The core is distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later, as stated in the upstream
@ffmpeg/core-mt package. See COPYING.GPLv2. The ffmpeg.wasm project wrapper uses
the MIT license included in LICENSE.ffmpeg-wasm.txt.

The original dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.js is shipped unchanged as ffmpeg-core.mjs.
SHA-256: 270a2e6ff945e173238610669a3f7132df5f9c52698a9bf708cf5c2ab6bda0de
The original dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.worker.js is shipped unchanged.
SHA-256: f77898d631dc010b45c29c23cb4379c611a7d7b131bf591d08a656bb729a4ca3

The original dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.wasm is split byte-for-byte into three
ascending numbered parts to fit the hosting asset size limit. The in-browser
worker joins these parts before instantiation. Reassemble with:
cat ffmpeg-core-0.bin ffmpeg-core-1.bin ffmpeg-core-2.bin > ffmpeg-core.wasm
SHA-256: be2c97605366b78f3f13e21b52e81a55a79e1f29c133b03a68ec187b1a2ec41a
